Vitally's public REST API for creating, updating, retrieving and listing the core Customer Success objects — Accounts, Organizations, Users, Tasks, Notes, Conversations and NPS Responses. Authentication is HTTP Basic using a Vitally REST API key as the username. List endpoints use cursor-based pagination ordered by updatedAt (default) or createdAt.
